dedupe_keys.name: decision support framework for lower temperature heating renovation solutions simulation results of the case study application

description: TU Delft publishes simulation outputs supporting a decision-support method for renovating existing Dutch dwellings for lower-temperature heating. The provider describes results used to benchmark the existing situation and compare renovation options for heating readiness. The simulation work took place during June and July 2024. Excel is the stated delivery format. The dataset is distinct from the related code bundle and stakeholder-validation workshop. Coverage: Coverage concerns Dutch dwellings. The description does not establish a nationwide sample, model grid resolution or individual simulation time steps. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: These are simulation outputs and not observations of completed renovations. The model and its performance were not reproduced. Simulation uses include comparison of building renovation and district-heating readiness scenarios. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
